article.title: Habitual dealing in slaves
article.content: Whoever habitually imports, exports, removes, buys, sells, traffics or deals in slaves, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term not exceeding ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
145Habitual dealing in slaves

Section 145 · Chapter VI · Of kidnapping, abduction, slavery and forced labour

Whoever habitually imports, exports, removes, buys, sells, traffics or deals in slaves, shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term not exceeding ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
